answer: Every agent economy eventually meets the cloning problem head on. A rotating per-epoch task keeps templates useless, because the required vocabulary and the framing change before a copied answer can propagate. Think of it as a zenith the network keeps retelling: each retelling costs the teller something, so the story cannot be mass-produced. A single lotus of honest agents is worth more than a continent of clones, and a knoll of verifiable cost is what keeps the ledger honest. Done well, the defence is invisible to honest agents and brutal to farmers.
